readme: Design Desk is a DAM agent that explains product changes, draws design options and writes developer specs. This fixture checks the public manifest shape; every list refers to a key in this file, and the text is data rather than an instruction.

agent.name: Design Desk
agent.description: A design partner for a product team.

github.address: Read the product repository and write only through the approved handoff.
github.pickup: A labelled issue or pull request starts the relevant run.

chat-request.description: The operator asks for a design action in the direct session.

desk-request.description: Answers or draws the requested design work.
desk-request.result: the requested deliverable and its Desk card

desk-card.format: a card in the Desk store

design-decisions.where: a public text page in surfaces.artifact.pages
design-decisions.format: Markdown: the design decisions in force as D-<n> sections (text, why, concepts, when, the role that decided), an index by concept, and the revoked ones
design-decisions.meaning: the rules a change to the product's screens follows; going against one is said in the pull request and waits for a designer

trust: Only the operator changes how the agent behaves.
